title: Buddha Jumps Over the Wall Beef Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful beef stew inspired by Chinese cuisine, with a unique combination of ingredients.
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onions and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the ground beef and cook until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Add the broken noodles, soy sauce, mushrooms, and beef broth. Stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then cover and transfer to the oven.
Bake at 300°F (150°C) for 1 hour, or until the stew is hot and the flavors have melded together.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped green onions and a drizzle of rice vinegar.
